subject: Expansion to additional apps at Crescent Labs — addendum & key provisioning
body_preview: Proposal for adding 5 new projects/apps, staggered API key provisioning, updated term (12->18 months) and DocuSign addendum link.
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Expansion to additional apps — initial plan and SOW

Hi Alicia,

Great speaking with you this morning — thanks for outlining the five additional projects Crescent wants to bring online next quarter. Per our call, I attached a concise SOW and the updated pricing grid that reflects staged volume discounts. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm which projects will be in the first wave (we suggest Projects A+B for Dec/Jan).
- Desired go-live window for each project (staggering helps with key provisioning).
- Any procurement timing constraints for an addendum vs full contract amendment.

I captured a proposed timeline in the attached SOW and a recommended API key rollout template. If Crescent is comfortable, we can convert the SOW into an addendum (18-month term, small per-token credit for commit) and route via DocuSign for signature.

Attachments: Crescent_SOW-draft.pdf; crescent-pricing-v2.csv; api-key-rollout-template.xlsx

Next steps: if you can confirm the first-wave projects and procurement contact, I’ll put together the DocuSign addendum and loop in our security team for any evidence they need.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com


From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@crescentlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@crescentlabs.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion to additional apps — initial plan and SOW

Jordan —

Thanks for the packet. A couple quick questions before we move to signature:

1) Our legal wants to confirm the proposed 18-month addendum vs extending the MSA — will there be any rate change after 18 months?
2) Can you confirm whether API keys will be scoped per project or per environment (we prefer per-project keys for auditing).
3) Procurement: we need to get an internal PO in place. Is Crescent expected to pre-pay for any commit discounts or is it billed monthly?

I’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up with procurement (cc’d) on Monday.

—Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product Ops, Crescent Labs
alicia@crescentlabs.com

On Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 09:14 AM Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Great speaking with you this morning — thanks for outlining the five additional projects Crescent wants to bring online next quarter...

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, procurement@crescentlabs.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion to additional apps — initial plan and SOW

Alicia —

Answers inline:

1) Term & pricing: The addendum we propose is an 18-month commitment at the rates shown in crescent-pricing-v2.csv. After 18 months the pricing will revert to the then-current published rates unless we agree to a renewal; we also include a 2% annual CPI clause in the draft. If you prefer the amendment to the MSA instead of a standalone addendum, legal can do that — functionally same economics.

2) API keys: We recommend per-project keys (matches your auditing preference). I’ve attached an API key rollout template that maps key names to project IDs and environments — Monica will own provisioning.

3) Billing: Commit discounts can be structured as monthly credits (no pre-pay required) or as an annual pre-pay if Crescent prefers a single invoice. Procurement should confirm preference on Monday.

I’ll prepare a DocuSign addendum for signature with the 18-month term and optional pre-pay checkbox. Tentative timeline: sign by 12/10 -> staggered provisioning start 12/13 -> Projects A+B go-live by 01/15.

Jordan

On Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 11:02 AM Alicia Gomez <alicia@crescentlabs.com> wrote:
> Jordan — Thanks for the packet. A couple quick questions before we move to signature...

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion to additional apps — initial plan and SOW

Hey team —

I’ll take point on the provisioning runbook. A few practical notes from ops:

- We’ll create per-project API keys scoped to each project ID and environment. Keys will be tagged (project:, env:, owner:) to make rotation and audit easier.
- For a five-project expansion I recommend a staggered rollout across three waves (2 / 2 / 1) to keep warm-up on our side predictable.
- I can deliver the initial keys for Projects A+B within 3 business days after DocuSign signature and the required IAM form from Crescent.
- For auditing, we can push a weekly usage export to a secure S3 bucket (read-only) — if Crescent wants that, we can include it in the addendum as a deliverable.

If you want, Marissa can confirm the discount structure we’ll tie to commit levels.

Cheers,
Monica
Monica Patel
Platform Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@crescentlabs.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion to additional apps — initial plan and SOW

Alicia — Jordan —

Quick commercial note: we can offer the staged volume discounts in crescent-pricing-v2.csv as follows:

- Wave 1 (Projects A+B): base rate with 5% commit credit for first 6 months.
- Waves 2+3: incremental credits that vest once monthly usage milestones are met.

If Crescent chooses annual pre-pay for the commit, we can increase the introductory credit to 8% for year one. I’m attaching a redline of the SOW with the credit structure called out. Let us know whether procurement prefers monthly crediting or an annual pre-pay.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-redline-Crescent-v1.pdf

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@crescentlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion to additional apps — initial plan and SOW

Thanks all — this looks sensible. Procurement prefers monthly credits (no pre-pay) and we’ll confirm the specific first-wave projects during Monday’s sync. Please go ahead and issue the DocuSign addendum with the monthly-credit option and per-project key approach.

Alicia

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 10:15 AM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com> wrote:
